questions.question: Explain how international migration has affected a named UK city. (4 marks)

points.text: In Bristol, international migration has brought cultural diversity - approximately 16% of the population was born outside the UK, with significant Somali, Polish and South Asian communities (1 mark). Migrants fill labour shortages in sectors like healthcare and construction, and bring entrepreneurial skills, establishing businesses particularly in areas like Easton and St Paul's (1 mark). questions.question: Describe two challenges of urban change in a named UK city. (4 marks)

points.text: In Bristol, housing affordability is a major challenge - average house prices of £350,000 are over 11 times the median salary, creating a severe shortage of affordable homes and over 16,000 on the housing waiting list (1 mark). questions.question: "Urban regeneration benefits some groups more than others." To what extent do you agree? Use a named UK city. (9 marks)

points.text: I agree that urban regeneration benefits some groups more than others. In Bristol, the Harbourside redevelopment created attractive apartments, restaurants and cultural venues (1 mark), but the new housing was predominantly expensive, excluding lower-income residents and effectively creating a wealthy enclave alongside deprived areas (1 mark).
